title: Grill and Griddle at once with George Foreman
text:
Grill and Griddle at once with George Foreman. George Foreman Dual Surface Griddle and Grill is an appliance with a familiar name. We own and use two different George Foreman grills in our home and since it’s a brand we trust, we had no problem welcoming a third grill into the fold.

The first thing you notice about this grill is the size. It’s a BIG grill, and it does take up considerable counter space. You need to make sure you have room to accommodate before you purchase. The other thing you notice is, of course, the dual nature of this appliance. It combines the features of a George Foreman Grill with those of a standard griddle. With this type of design, you can cook different foods using the different surfaces, so it does have some good, practical use.

I like the idea of a dual cooking device like this one, but once you use this appliance, you do notice a few problems. The greatest issue for me is the small size of the griddle surface. It’s just not large enough to make it useful for a family, as it can hold only a few fried eggs and pancakes at once. I was surprised when I first looked at the actual grill because I assumed it would be split down the middle, with the griddle on one side and the grill on the other. Instead, the grill sections are on both sides with the griddle in the center. It works, I suppose, but a little more attention to the griddle surface would have been better.

Overall, my opinion of this appliance is mixed. It seems to heat well and prepare food with a good deal of consistency, but when we griddle, it’s usually a large number of items all at once and this appliance isn’t large enough to accommodate. So, we will likely stick with using or regular George Foreman Grill and regular griddle when we need this dual- action, but that doesn’t mean this is a bad appliance. It does have its merits and it does carry the George Foreman name. Add everything together and I think the good outweigh the bad, enough to award this with an average rating and small recommendation.

product_metadata.title: George Foreman GFG240X Dual Surface Griddle + Grill, Ceramic
description: Stay flexible in the kitchen with the George Foreman Dual Surface Griddle + Grill! It combines the functionality of a traditional griddle surface with the fat-removing slope of a George Foreman grill to make it the ultimate cooking machine. The 242 square inch ceramic-coated, nonstick cooking surface fits up to 15 servings so you can make eggs and pancakes on the griddle portion, and use the two sloped grilling surfaces to remove some fat from bacon and sausage. Plus, the adjustable temperature dial gives you complete control over the heat of the griddle for great results every time. Use the George Foreman Dual Surface Griddle + Grill for your next family breakfast and you’ll see just how much it can simplify your cooking!
